meta.title: bia — turn anything into someone
meta.description: bia turns any computer or server into someone: an AI agent on WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger and Instagram that takes calls, remembers and acts on its own.
meta.og_description: A helpful AI personality with a computer of its own, in your messengers, in your language.
